name: Preview budget, blocked turns, and replans

tasks.name: Preview budget exhaustion does not invite retry
tasks.prompt: The current turn hit preview_budget_exhausted on a large command output. Using only the preserved outcome metadata, state the next step: run one verifier with an && chain and no pipes, then synthesize. Do not repeat the exhausted call or an equivalent call.

tasks.name: Blocked turn resumes from checkpoint
tasks.prompt: The previous turn ended blocked with a checkpoint. Describe how to resume from the checkpoint with prior progress intact, using one tool-free synthesis pass. Do not claim a session-archive resume ID when the handoff has no archive.

tasks.name: Mid-execution replan continues the run
tasks.prompt: New evidence invalidates the current approach mid-run. Describe how to keep existing scopes, record a falsifier for the new plan, and continue the same run on plan.delta events. Keep generalization notes bounded and task-scoped.
